agentPrompt.en: Review the current presentation and selected slides. First ask how I would like to change them. Use the document plugin tools to read, edit, and save.
agentPrompt.zh-Hans: 请查看当前演示文稿和选中的幻灯片，先询问我希望如何修改。通过文档插件提供的工具读取、修改和保存。

agentUnavailable.en: The Host has no connected Agent. Open the Host Agent panel to continue.
agentUnavailable.zh-Hans: 当前 Host 尚未连接 Agent 插件，请在 Host 的 Agent 面板中操作。

featureDisabled.en: This action is currently disabled by the Host configuration.
featureDisabled.zh-Hans: 此操作已被宿主配置停用。

unsupportedOperation.en: This offline plugin does not support this action: {operation}
unsupportedOperation.zh-Hans: 此离线插件暂不支持此操作：{operation}

fileTooLarge.en: The presentation exceeds the configured file size limit.
fileTooLarge.zh-Hans: 演示文稿超过了配置的文件大小限制。

operationFailed.en: The operation could not be completed. Your current document is retained.
operationFailed.zh-Hans: 暂时无法完成操作，已保留当前文稿。

languageRejected.en: The language update is incompatible. The previous language remains active.
languageRejected.zh-Hans: 语言更新不兼容，已保留原有语言。

openFailed.en: Unable to open the PPTX presentation.

previewNote.en: Choose a presentation to inspect its structure through authorized MCP tools.
previewNote.zh-Hans: 选择演示文稿后，受授权的 MCP 工具将返回页面结构。
